nightly._how: max_new_products: products started per night. new_types_per_night: top picks from stages/pick.py added as new types (teardown that night, products from the next night). Types with no product yet are built first.

pricing._how: Brief check refuses a price under the floor (from insights.price). Etsy's API cannot create sales, so the launch sale is set up by hand in Shop Manager > Marketing > Sales and discounts; listing.txt says how.
